scripts.tauri:prep: mkdir -p src-tauri/backend/bin src-tauri/bin && (test -f src-tauri/bin/node || cp $(which node) src-tauri/bin/node) && rsync -a --delete --exclude='src-tauri' --exclude='dist' --exclude='.git' --exclude='node_modules/electron' --exclude='node_modules/app-builder-bin' src public apks node_modules index.js package.json src-tauri/backend/ && cp src-tauri/bin/node src-tauri/backend/bin/node && (cd src-tauri/backend && npm prune --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund) && rm -rf src-tauri/backend/node_modules/.bin src-tauri/backend/node_modules/@types src-tauri/backend/node_modules/vue src-tauri/backend/node_modules/@vue && find src-tauri/backend/node_modules -name '*.map' -delete
scripts.tauri:build: tauri build && mkdir -p 'dist/方案A-Tauri' && rm -rf 'dist/方案A-Tauri/HQ Network Debugger.app' && cp -R 'src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/HQ Network Debugger.app' 'dist/方案A-Tauri/' && cp 'src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/HQ Network Debugger_1.0.0_aarch64.dmg' 'dist/方案A-Tauri/'
scripts.electron:build: electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.json && rm -rf 'dist/方案B-Electron/HQ Network Debugger.app' && mv 'dist/方案B-Electron/mac-arm64/HQ Network Debugger.app' 'dist/方案B-Electron/' && codesign --force --deep --sign - 'dist/方案B-Electron/HQ Network Debugger.app' && rm -rf 'dist/方案B-Electron/mac-arm64' 'dist/方案B-Electron/builder-effective-config.yaml' 'dist/方案B-Electron/builder-debug.yml' 'dist/方案B-Electron/'*.blockmap
scripts.icon:gen: tauri icon icons-design/icon-prism-3d.png && cp src-tauri/icons/128x128.png public/favicon.png
